digest.component_or_area: live provenance oracle / inbound Jira DC reconciliation test
propositions: The test assertion greps for raw Jira key (e.g., RBJNAZV-1) against json.dumps(ticket), but the local id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) and the raw key is never included in the ticket payload, only in the binding store
The test cannot distinguish whether the ticket was created or not created because the assertion targets an assumed output shape rather than what the inbound path actually writes
The test must be fixed to assert exact match on ticket id derived from _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally validate the binding store maps that local id to remote_key

Prior masking defects prevented this oracle from running: store was empty, PAT-cap bug killed setup, and the oracle itself could not pass — all three must be fixed before the inbound half of the epic AC can be proven
